ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The Ogre platform of MyGUI (Ogre 14 API): render queue listener, hardware vertex buffers, Ogre textures and render targets. Textures and data go through the Ogre resource system; the Ogre glue plugins of GUCEF route that into the virtual file system and gucefIMAGE. Built with the Ogre module of this code base.
